claims.body: The Ducks shoot a lot, and the Flames are one of the league’s worst at keeping shots down. Look for a big shot total.

claims.head: Shots should fly both ways
claims.call: The game’s pace score is above 106, faster than either team’s usual.
claims.see: More than 70 shots between them at 5-on-5, on goal or wide, which usually means 57 or more shots on goal on the scoreboard.
claims.body: Calgary plays some of the league’s fastest games, and so does Anaheim. We think this one runs hotter than either team’s usual.

notes.text: S. Honzek is out week to week (lower body injury) and missed their last game. He is one of their most valuable skaters. Y. Sharangovich has taken his spot beside M. Backlund and J. Farabee.
J. Huberdeau is on injured reserve (hip surgery) and has not played this season. He is a top-six forward.
M. Pospíšil has started killing penalties: on the ice for 30% of the team’s shorthanded time in 5 games, up from 2% last season.
T. Terry is on long-term injured reserve and has not played this season. He is one of their most valuable skaters.
C. Gauthier is out (upper body injury), reported after he played in their last game. He is a top-six forward.
R. Poehling is out 6-8 weeks (mcl sprain), reported after he played in their last game.

ANA.head: Anaheim should be favored
ANA.body: Even though Anaheim will be without Terry, Anaheim has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and gets Greer back and has home-ice advantage. It’s on Calgary to make it a game, and they can if they keep the shots coming.

CGY.head: Anaheim should be favored
CGY.body: Even though Anaheim will be without Terry, Anaheim has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and gets Greer back and has home-ice advantage. Calgary can still win it if they keep the shots coming, but a lot has to go their way.

story.head: Round two
paras: The Ducks won the first meeting this season, 4-2 in Calgary. The Ducks have won two in a row. The Flames are on a five-game losing streak.
The Ducks shoot a lot, and the Flames give up plenty. Both teams like a fast game.
